title: Syzygy repository manifest (syzygy.yml)
description: Canonical schema for syzygy.yml across all Syzygy layers (foundation, ui, core, services, ai, base) and app/example repos. Legacy keys (layer, foundation, syzygy_<layer>) are accepted by the reference validator with a warning; see engineering/tooling/validate-syzygy/validate.py.

type.description: Layer or repo kind. Canonical key; replaces the legacy 'layer' key.

license.description: SPDX identifier. The licence holder is a pending decision; see repository-standard.md.

version.description: Bare strict semver, no v prefix. Must equal the release tag.

syzygy_foundation.description: Version constraint on syzygy-foundation-*, for example ">=3.0.0". Required for every type except foundation.

contracts.description: Contracts provided by the repo (list of names, or name/version objects for base repos).

dependencies.description: Dependency constraints (list or mapping), used by repos that depend on several layers.

demonstrates.description: Example-only. Layers the example app demonstrates. See engineering/standards/example-apps-standard.md.

version_constraint.description: Version range for the library, for example ">=3.0.0". Bare semver operands, no v prefix.

depends_on.description: Example-only. Library repositories the example consumes, with version constraints.
